subject: Summit follow-up: quick demo for Greenline — confirm a slot
messages:
From: Hannah Lee <hannah@greenline.ai>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.inference>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.inference>
Date: Tue, 8 Jun 2027 16:02:00 -0400
Subject: Summit follow-up — interested in a short demo

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks again for the conversation at the Northeast AI Summit this morning — we were impressed by the latency numbers you mentioned on stage. Tom and I registered via the event landing page and wanted to take a quick 20–30 minute look at how Redwood would fit into Greenline's workflow (low-latency authoring + embeddings for search).

Would you or someone on your team be able to run a short walkthrough next week? We're US Eastern timezone; afternoons are best for us (after 2pm ET).

A few objectives:
- High-level latency/cost tradeoffs for 8–12k monthly active inference calls
- How private deployment integrates with our VPC and KMS
- Example prompt patterns for assisted authoring

If you want, I can share the doc we use internally for architecture/context.

Best,
Hannah
Hannah Lee
Product Manager, Greenline AI
Phone: +1 (617) 555-0142

Attachment: greenline-summit-notes.txt (referenced, not attached in this mail)

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.inference>
To: Hannah Lee <hannah@greenline.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.inference>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference>
Date: Tue, 8 Jun 2027 18:10:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Summit follow-up — interested in a short demo

Hi Hannah — great meeting you at the summit and thanks for reaching out.

Ben (cc'd) is our AE who handles Greenline; Ben — would you be able to take this customer for a 25-minute walkthrough? My calendar is flexible but Ben will be your best contact for scheduling and technical depth.

Hannah: we can do next-week slots Tue/Wed/Thu afternoons ET. I dropped a short agenda PDF (Redwood-Demo-Agenda.pdf) and a pricing one-pager into this thread for context.

Proposed agenda (25 min):
1) Intros + context (3 min)
2) Demo: hosted vs private deployment paths (10 min)
3) Discussion: latency/cost for your workload (7 min)
4) Next steps & follow-up artifacts (5 min)

If that works, Ben will send a calendar invite. Also please attach the internal doc you mentioned if you'd like us to review beforehand.

Cheers,
Jasmine Liu
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
jasmine@redwood.inference

Attachment: Redwood-Demo-Agenda.pdf, Pricing-OnePager.pdf
